name: boringstack-site
description: Public, static marketing site for BoringStack. Astro, output static, served by nginx.

scripts.build:ci: env SITE_URL=https://boringstack.example.com APP_URL=https://app.boringstack.example.com CONTACT_EMAIL=hello@boringstack.example.com sh -c 'astro build && node scripts/render-nginx.mjs'
scripts.validate: bun run format:check && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build:ci && bun run test:output

//overrides._: Pins patched transitive versions, mirroring apps/docs. Build-time tooling only: the deployed site is static nginx output.
//overrides.devalue: Patched build-time serialization (GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p, then GHSA-4q55-j62x-fr9h, GHSA-9rgm-9g3h-6x36, GHSA-hx4r-w6wj-j8fg, GHSA-j22f-vq7h-c4qm, GHSA-mcm9-63f2-9j32, GHSA-r9w8-h9r3-54w4, GHSA-wf3x-273g-mvxv, GHSA-x5rw-q4pp-hg5g). 5.8.1 is vulnerable; 5.9.3 patches them. Pulled in by Astro.
//overrides.sharp: Patched image processing (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c, GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w). 0.35.4 is vulnerable; 0.35.5 patches it. Build-time social-card rendering only.
//overrides.undici: Patched undici (GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g, and the 7.29.0 batch fixed in 7.29.1). Build-time fetch tooling only. Mirrors the docs and UI app pins.
//overrides.fflate: Patched fflate (GHSA-px8p-9vwx-vf98, infinite loop on malformed ZIP64 archives). 0.7.3 is vulnerable; 0.8.3 patches it. satori pins fflate exactly to 0.7.3 in every release, so this forces the patched line for the OG image renderer. Build-time social-card rendering only.
